hotel_name: Lemon Tree Premier, Leisure Valley 2, Gurugram

positive_snippets:
I had a wonderful stay at the hotel. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, and the overall atmosphere was very pleasant. I would especially like to highlight the excellent service provided by Amit from the housekeeping team. He was extremely polite, attentive, and always ready to help with anything I needed. His commitment to ensuring guests have a comfortable stay truly stood out.
Thank you for the great hospitality—looking forward to staying again!

I had a pleasant stay here, the location is excellent, the room was comfortable, and the food, especially breakfast was very good. However, I was irritated to find no shampoo or shower gel while taking a bath, though it was resolved after I reported. Room service cleaning could be better, and the gym needs improvement and proper maintenance. Overall, a good stay with a few areas that need attention.
Very cosy and comfortable rooms.Well connected place having true Local Warm  ambience. Enough space in louoto relax or have discussion with your friends or business partners.
negative_snippets: The room was perfect and comfortable. However, the swimming pool was under maintenance and there was no in-built heater in the room. Lunch buffet was not available. Dinner buffet was just okay, but breakfast buffet was good. Overall experience did not justify the price paid. Parking you forgot.
